evals.name: taskflow-api-express
evals.prompt: I recently inherited the codebase at <PROJECT>. I need to onboard new engineers onto it. Please generate a complete set of project documentation that explains what the system is, how it's architected, its data model, its tech stack, the core runtime flows, and its API surface — something a new dev can read to understand the whole system.
evals.expected_output: docs/ with OVERVIEW.md, ARCHITECTURE.md (mermaid component/flow diagram), TECHSTACK.md, DATAMODEL.md (mermaid erDiagram with User/Project/Task + TaskStatus enum), COREFEATURE.md (mermaid sequenceDiagram per flow: register, login, complete-task→email queue), API.md (real endpoints: POST /auth/register, /auth/login, GET/POST /projects, /tasks, PATCH /tasks/:id/complete), and a self-contained document.html. All claims grounded in the real files; no invented tables/endpoints.

evals.name: loglens-cli-no-api-no-db
evals.prompt: Generate onboarding documentation for the project at <PROJECT> so a new contributor can quickly understand what it does, how it's structured, and how the pieces fit together.
evals.expected_output: docs/ suite for a Python CLI with NO HTTP API and NO datastore. The key test: API.md and DATAMODEL.md must honestly say 'Not applicable' (no fabricated REST endpoints or DB schema), while OVERVIEW/ARCHITECTURE/TECHSTACK/COREFEATURE are real (click CLI, parser→stats→report pipeline, analyze/stats commands with sequence diagrams). Plus document.html.
